name: Depth (3D Lighting & Focus)
description: Works out how far away everything in a video is, so you can add lights that fall on the scene, realistic background blur, fog, and titles that sit behind people.
details: Video Depth Anything Small in ONNX: a DINOv2 ViT-S encoder run per frame and a temporal DPT head run per 32-frame window, which keeps depth steady from frame to frame instead of flickering. Outputs relative inverse depth. Ships fp32 and fp16 weights; fp32 is used unless a GPU execution provider is active. Package id: depth.vda-small.
author: CutWire
